D5/S1/Words/Mechanical/SilverSlopeAbelia.name: D5.S1.Words.Mechanical.silverPell_determinant
D5/S1/Words/Mechanical/SilverSlopeAbelia.signature: theorem silverPell_determinant (k : Nat) : (P (k + 2) : Int) * P k - (P (k + 1) : Int) ^ 2 = (-1 : Int) ^ (k + 1)

D5/S1/Words/Mechanical/SilverSlopeAbelia.name: D5.S1.Words.Mechanical.silverPell_error_formula
D5/S1/Words/Mechanical/SilverSlopeAbelia.signature: theorem silverPell_error_formula (k : Nat) : (P (k + 1) : Real) * silverSlope - P k = (-1 : Real) ^ k * silverSlope ^ (k + 1)

D5/S1/Words/Mechanical/SilverSlopeAbelia.name: D5.S1.Words.Mechanical.silver_best_approximation
D5/S1/Words/Mechanical/SilverSlopeAbelia.signature: theorem silver_best_approximation (k m : Nat) (hm : 0 < m) (hmq : m < P (k + 2)) (z : Int) : silverSlope ^ (k + 1) ≤ |(m : Real) * silverSlope - z|

D5/S1/Words/Mechanical/SilverSlopeAbelia.name: D5.S1.Words.Mechanical.silver_phase_mass
D5/S1/Words/Mechanical/SilverSlopeAbelia.signature: theorem silver_phase_mass (k : Nat) : ((P (k + 2) : Real) + silverSlope * P (k + 1)) * silverSlope ^ (k + 1) = 1
